query: How is Aurora retrieval evaluated and what release criteria are used?

selected.text: The release gate requires at least ninety percent citation coverage and Recall at five above eighty percent on the held-out set.
The Aurora retrieval stack combines lexical BM25 retrieval with a vector index. The result merger deduplicates candidates before reranking.
Aurora is evaluated with Recall at five, mean reciprocal rank, and answer citation coverage on a manually labeled question set.
Aurora uses a hybrid search pipeline and evaluates retrieval with Recall at five and mean reciprocal rank.

[A09] Quality policy
The release gate requires at least ninety percent citation coverage and Recall at five above eighty percent on the held-out set.

[A01] System architecture
The Aurora retrieval stack combines lexical BM25 retrieval with a vector index. The result merger deduplicates candidates before reranking.

[A04] Evaluation guide copy
Aurora is evaluated with Recall at five, mean reciprocal rank, and answer citation coverage on a manually labeled question set.

[A10] FAQ
Aurora uses a hybrid search pipeline and evaluates retrieval with Recall at five and mean reciprocal rank.
limitations: Token counts are estimates; use a model tokenizer before deployment.
Scores are lexical heuristics, not learned relevance or answer-faithfulness estimates.
No LLM is called and no generated answer quality is claimed.
